info.title: Trnch API
info.summary: Free Robinhood Chain rug check, wallet scan and quotes for bots and AI agents
info.description:
Free, no key, no wallet: /check (rug and honeypot check of any Robinhood Chain token, chainId 4663), /scan (check everything a wallet holds), /top, /stats and /quote (best of eight routers). With an API key: the Heat feed, /buy and /sell. Trade new Robinhood Chain tokens through trnch: a live feed of launches screened by trnch (rugs, honeypots, scam contracts, heavy sell taxes and copycats are kept out and refused), and the best route across eight routers (KyberSwap, LI.FI, Uniswap, 0x, SushiSwap, 1inch, Velora, Nordstern). Non-custodial: every transaction is returned ready to sign and is sent by your own wallet. Fee 0.25% per swap (0.10% between major assets such as ETH and USDG, 0.05% between a Stock Token and a major asset, 0.50% for tokens under 24 h old or with no known launch time), already deducted from quotes. Selling a token Trnch keeps out is allowed; buying one is refused. Also available as an MCP server at https://trnch.fun/api/mcp. Quotes and swaps (/quote, /build, /buy, /sell) carry no restriction on automated use: agents are welcome to trade. Raw data (the Heat feed and rankings) is licensed only for trading through Trnch (https://docs.trnch.fun/legal/terms). Check results (/api/bot/v1/check and /api/bot/v1/check/batch) are free to display and relay with a link to the token page on trnch (tokenUrl).

Versioning: /v1 stays stable. A breaking change ships as /v2, announced at least 90 days ahead with Deprecation and Sunset headers on /v1.

Pay-per-call tools (x402 v2, no key, no account): /api/x402/token-verdict, /api/x402/token-risk, /api/x402/wallet-risk, /api/x402/token-origin, /api/x402/top-24h, /api/x402/quote. Start with token-verdict ($0.02): verdict, risk categories, one-line summary, origin, tokenUrl and cardUrl in one call. token-verdict, wallet-risk and quote take chain (robinhood, base; default robinhood): chain=base reads Base (8453) at the same price. Each 402 offers three payment options at the same dollar price: USDC on Base (eip155:8453), USDC on Solana (solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp) or USDG on Robinhood Chain (eip155:4663), 6 decimals. Prices are in each operation. Building a swap is free (Bot API).
info.x-guidance: Two surfaces on https://trnch.fun. (1) Pay-per-call x402 tools, no key or account, start with GET /api/x402/token-verdict?address= ($0.02: verdict, risk categories, one-line summary, origin, tokenUrl and cardUrl for a Robinhood Chain token in one call). Also /token-risk?address= ($0.01), /token-origin?address= ($0.01), /wallet-risk?address= ($0.03), /top-24h ($0.01), /quote?tokenIn=&tokenOut=&amountIn= ($0.01). Add chain=base to token-verdict, wallet-risk or quote for a Base (8453) token or wallet, same price (chain values: robinhood, base; default robinhood). Call without payment to get HTTP 402 and the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header: accepts lists three options, pick one and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Option 1: USDC on Base (eip155:8453, 6 decimals, EIP-3009). Option 2: USDC on Solana (solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp, 6 decimals, partially signed SPL TransferChecked, fee payer from extra.feePayer). Option 3: USDG on Robinhood Chain (eip155:4663, 6 decimals). Same price in dollars on all, the runtime 402 is authoritative. By paying you accept the Trnch Terms: https://docs.trnch.fun/legal/terms. (2) The free Bot API under /api/bot/v1 (check, scan, top, stats, quote need no key; heat, build, buy, sell, confirm and alerts need an API key sent as Authorization: Bearer trnch_bot_..., obtained from /api/bot/v1/register). Building a swap is free: Trnch earns its fee on the swap itself. Non-custodial: transactions are returned unsigned. Signals, never guarantees.

get.summary: Free, no key: is this token a rug? Trnch check
get.description: Check any Robinhood Chain token for rugs, honeypots, scams and copycats before you buy. Returns status (kept_out, in_heat, seen, unknown), a public risk category, rugged and dumped, plus creator { history, tokensInHeat } or null (launch history of the token's creator, bucketed, context only, not part of the verdict), and builder or null (what HEY Research reports about the team's shipping, per HEY, separate from the verdict; not a rating), verified (true for tokens verified by trnch and official assets), summary (one line to post as is), tokenUrl and cardUrl (the token page and its share image). No key. 120 calls per minute per IP. A signal, never a guarantee.

parameters.description: Token contract address on Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663)

get.summary: Free, no key: scan a wallet, every token it holds with its Trnch verdict
get.description: Every ERC-20 a Robinhood Chain wallet holds: address, symbol, balance (raw and decimals), valueUsd when known, the same Trnch verdict as /check (status, category, rugged, dumped), creator (launch history of the token's creator, bucketed, context only, not part of the verdict; null when unknown), flagged, canSell (false only for a confirmed honeypot) and, for a flagged token that can be sold, a sell hint (the POST /sell call and a trnch.fun/trade link). Flagged tokens first. ETH, WETH, USDG and official assets are listed as official, without a check. At most 100 other tokens are returned, flagged first, then tokens with no known price, then the most valuable (truncated: true when more are held). Cached 60 s per wallet. No key. 20 calls per minute per IP. A signal, never a guarantee.

post.summary: Subscribe a webhook to Trnch alerts for a wallet
post.description: Every 5 minutes, a token the wallet holds that Trnch newly flagged is sent as one signed JSON POST { event: wallet.flag, id, initial, wallet, token, verdict, canSell, sell } (X-TRNCH-Signature, HMAC-SHA256 of t.body with the secret returned once here). The first time a subscription is read, each token the wallet already holds that Trnch keeps out is sent once with initial: true. A failed delivery is retried on the next run, up to 3 attempts per token. The URL must be https, a public domain name, port 443; IPs, localhost, private ranges and internal names are refused, and the name is resolved at each send and the connection is pinned to the checked address. 3 subscriptions per key, 5 active per wallet across its keys, 20 per destination host; the same wallet again replaces its URL; 10 failed deliveries in a row disable the subscription.

201.description: Created: the subscription and its secret, shown once

default.description: Error: { error }. 400 invalid parameters (including a webhookUrl that is not https, not a public domain name or not port 443), 401 missing or invalid key, 409 limit reached (3 alerts per key, 5 active per wallet across its keys, 20 per destination host), 429 rate limited (retry-after), 503 alerts unavailable
